spec-divergent: evaluateDecompositionGate return type tightened beyond spec. §4.4 specifies `block: string | null` in the function signature; code defines DecompositionGateResult with `block: ParallelDecompositionBlock | null`. TypeScript-compatible subtype refinement but diverges from the literal spec contract. Story 2 (Gate impl) will import this interface and must match; Story 5 (integration) callers written to the spec signature may need adjustment. Recommend aligning spec §4.4 signature to `block: ParallelDecompositionBlock | null` OR reverting the interface to `block: string | null`.
